name: Personal AI Assistant
description: AI chat assistant that answers only the owner's WhatsApp numbers or @lid mapping, with short per-chat conversation memory.
author: OpenWA operator

apiBaseUrl.title: API base URL
apiBaseUrl.description: Base URL of an OpenAI-compatible API, e.g. https://api.z.ai/api/paas/v4 or https://api.openai.com/v1. Must be https; an https host set here is added to the outbound allowlist automatically.

apiKey.title: API key
apiKey.description: Bearer key for the provider. Stored as a secret and sent only to the API base URL.

model.title: Model
model.description: Model id sent with every request.

ownerNumbers.title: Owner numbers (comma separated)
ownerNumbers.description: Only these phone numbers get an answer; everyone else is ignored. International format without +, e.g. 6281234567890,628999888777.

systemPrompt.default: Kamu adalah asisten pribadi di WhatsApp. Jawab dalam bahasa Indonesia yang santai dan jelas. Bantu soal pemrograman, ide, penjelasan kode, dan tugas sehari-hari. Pakai format WhatsApp: *tebal*, _miring_, tanpa tabel markdown. Jaga jawaban tetap ringkas kecuali diminta detail.
systemPrompt.title: System prompt
systemPrompt.description: Instructions for tone and scope. Not secret: never put confidential data here.

respondInGroups.title: Also respond in groups
respondInGroups.description: Off by default. When on, group messages from an owner number are answered too.

maxOutputTokens.title: Max output tokens
maxOutputTokens.description: Sent as max_tokens, bounding reply length and cost.

maxInputChars.title: Max input characters
maxInputChars.description: Incoming text is cut to this many characters before it reaches the provider.

maxRepliesPerChatPerHour.title: Max replies per chat per hour
maxRepliesPerChatPerHour.description: Per-chat hourly cap on provider calls. Kept in memory, so a restart resets it.

timeoutMs.title: Request timeout (ms)
timeoutMs.description: Provider request timeout, clamped to 1000-25000 ms.

ownerLids.title: Owner lid ids (comma separated, optional)
ownerLids.description: Privacy ids (@lid digits) allowed to use the assistant when the gateway has not learned their phone mapping yet. Leave empty to rely on ownerNumbers + mapping.

id.name: Asisten AI Pribadi
id.description: Asisten chat AI yang hanya membalas nomor WhatsApp pemilik, dengan ingatan percakapan singkat per chat.

maxRepliesPerChatPerHour.title: Maks balasan per chat per jam
